caption: The drawing depicts a lidded tankard with a large, rounded handle extending from the right side of the vessel. The tankard features a domed, hinged lid with a thumb lever attached to the top, and ornate detailing is visible around the base and on the thumb lever. The object is shaded in tones of gray and black, giving it a metallic appearance consistent with silver or pewter. Above the tankard, in the upper right corner of the image, there is a circular emblem that contains interwoven letters and the text “A·V·H” underneath it. The drawing is framed by a thin rectangular border, and the entire composition has a slightly yellowed background, suggestive of aged paper.
title: Silver Tankard
